subject: Post-demo: buy motion mapping + MSA/DPA sequencing for NovaHealth
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novahealth.co>, Sasha Petrov <sasha.petrov@novahealth.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: buy motion mapping + MSA/DPA sequencing for NovaHealth

Jordan / Sasha — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned on path to contract: 

What we covered (short):
- Demo walkthrough of inference latency/cost controls and Private VPC deployment options
- Data residency and KMS/HSM integration highlights you asked about
- High-level pricing bands for hosted vs dedicated vs private

Key decision ingredients you called out:
1) Economics owner wants predictable monthly spend and a clear overage policy
2) Security wants proof of audit logs + SOC2 scope for hosted endpoints
3) Legal/procurement want an MSA + DPA with a simple redline path and target 10–15 business day turn time

Proposed immediate plan: 
- We share a minimal MSA redline (start point) and a DPA template for NovaHealth legal to review — goal: initial redline back within 10 business days.
- Marissa to assemble a short answers pack for the security checklist (SOC 2, audit logs, KMS) by EOD tomorrow.
- Karthik will draft a suggested routing sequence for procurement/legal signers (who to engage and when) and a comms cadence to keep review moving.

Can you confirm the internal owners (economic, security, legal/procurement) and an ideal target signature date you’re aiming for so we can align resources? Also confirm whether you prefer us to send the initial redline as tracked changes in Word or via DocuSign redline flow.

I’ve attached a starter MSA redline and our procurement Qs to accelerate review.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com]

Subject: Re: Post-demo: buy motion mapping + MSA/DPA sequencing for NovaHealth

Karthik — great session. Short answers per your asks: 

Owners & timeline:
- Economic owner: Me (Jordan Ellis, Dir. Product) — primary decision by Dec 10 to align with Q4 spend forecast.
- Security owner: Sasha Petrov (copied) — will validate SOC2 scope and the audit log approach.
- Legal/Procurement: Procurement team (procure@novahealth.co) + Sasha for legal review. Procurement prefers to see a Word tracked-changes MSA to start.

Target signature: aiming for Dec 20 (optimistic) — realistic window Dec 20–Jan 10 depending on redline depth. We’re pushing internally to land before year-end but need to avoid surprises.

On turn times: procurement typically returns an initial redline in 7–12 business days if the MSA is reasonably standard. If we can provide a short redline summary and call out high-risk clauses, that helps speed review.

Next steps from our side:
- Sasha will run the SOC2/audit-logs checklist this week and come back with any blockers.
- Procurement will accept Word tracked changes for the MSA initial pass.

Thanks — send the Word redline and a 1-page summary of the material legal items and we’ll circulate.

Jordan
Jordan Ellis | Director, Product
NovaHealth
[j.ellis@novahealth.co]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: buy motion mapping + MSA/DPA sequencing for NovaHealth

Marissa / Ben — Jordan confirmed owners and prefers Word tracked changes. Jordan is targeting Dec 20 but realistic into early Jan. Procurement expects 7–12 business days on first pass.

Ask for you both:
- Marissa: please prioritize the security answers pack (SOC2 scope, audit log export samples, KMS/HSM integration notes). Can you also produce a 1-page "legal highlights" doc that calls out: data residency, data processing, incident response SLAs, subprocessor list and our recommended defaults for indemnity/limitation? We’ll attach that with the Word redline. Target EOD tomorrow for both.
- Ben: I may need you to review the recommended commercial fallback (60-day trial + consume credits) — if legal drags into Jan we should propose a bridge arrangement.

Routing proposal (suggested sequence):
1) Send Word redline + 1-page legal highlights (we) -> Procurement (procure@) + Sasha (legal)
2) Procurement does initial pass (7–12 BDs)
3) Sasha/Legal escalate specific legal items to escalation lane if >2 rounds or high-risk clauses
4) Economics to approve final commercial terms (Jordan)
5) Signatures via DocuSign once procurement/legal concur

If that sequence sounds good I’ll prepare the Word redline and a short email template for us to send to procurement so they have the context and urgent target.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Karthik — attaching the security pack and the 1-page legal highlights as requested. Quick notes below.

[Attachment: NovaHealth_security_answers_pack.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
[Attachment: NovaHealth_legal_highlights_onepager.pdf (pdf, 8KB)]

Security highlights:
- SOC2: We are in-scope for SOC2 Type II (controls mapped across infra + application). Attached deck includes the control mapping and recent audit date.
- Audit logs: We provide per-tenant audit logs with a 90-day hot window and archived exports on request (30–90 day retrieval SLA depending on retention policy).
- KMS: We integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS & Azure Key Vault). HSM options available for Private on-prem deployments.

Legal highlights (one-pager summary):
- Data processing: DPA template included; standard data-subject rights flow.
- Incident response: 72-hour notification for security incidents, 24-hour initial acknowledgement to customer.
- Indemnity & liability: We propose mutual indemnity with a $5M liability cap, carveouts for gross negligence.

I’ve also created a lightweight redline checklist that maps likely high-touch clauses (IP, liability, data location, subprocessing). If procurement wants, I can join the first 30-minute redline sync to walk through the highlights.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
